final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ram.ordervault AS reference, o.orderflow AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM riskandmargin ram JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY ram.ordervault, o.orderflow), step2 AS (SELECT status, SUM(count) AS total_count FROM step1 GROUP BY status), step3 AS (SELECT s1.reference, s1.status, s1.count, CAST(s1.count AS REAL) / s2.total_count AS ratio FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.status = s2.status), step4 AS (SELECT status, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3 GROUP BY status) SELECT s3.reference, s3.status, s3.count, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS difference FROM step3 s3 JOIN step4 s4 ON s3.status = s4.status WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
